name: Summer RISE
org: Montgomery County Public Schools, Department of Partnerships
what_you_do: Get a 5-week, 50-hour summer work experience with a business, agency, college or nonprofit in a career field you choose, in person, virtual or both.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors in Montgomery County Public Schools with parent or guardian permission. Must be free weekdays Jun 21 to Jul 23, 2027, 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.
deadline_text: Student registration opens in January and runs January to February (year not stated on the page). Placements are announced in April or May.
how_to_apply: Register online (parent or guardian reads the Parent/Guardian Agreement first), choose your top three career areas and in-person or virtual preference. If accepted, attend a mandatory workshop on professional skills and financial literacy.
notes: Hours are set by each host. Because it is a stipend (if funded) role, ask your school counselor whether a Maryland work permit applies. Maryland rule (Maryland Department of Labor): work permits are required for all minors under 18 to work in Maryland, issued only after a job offer.
